question: Which of the following was the guest nation at the Hyderabad Literary Festival 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is ' United Kingdom'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Hyderabad Literary Festival is a literary festival held in Telangana , Hyderabad.**

 
• It is a 3-day annual event that celebrates creativity in all its forms.
 
• Hyderabad Literary Festival is organized by Hyderabad Literary Trust in association with the Department of Tourism, Government of Telangana, and with the support of several academic, literary, cultural organizations and publishing houses.
 
• The guest nation for HLF 2022 is the United Kingdom and the Indian language in focus was Punjabi.
